items.basis: Plastics Engineering (Wiley) 'eco-molding' cover story: efficient benchmarks 0.3 kWh/kg thin-walled short cycle, 0.6 kWh/kg thicker part moulded slowly

items.basis: ACEEE 2005 Vermont case study: hydraulic 0.278 kWh/lb, all-electric 0.073 kWh/lb, same parts, one week metered. 0.278 ÷ 0.4536 = 0.613 kWh/kg; 0.073 ÷ 0.4536 = 0.161 kWh/kg (all-electric)
items.notes: Old; machine only (no dryers/chillers).

items.basis: ecoinvent dataset average electricity for injection moulding (as reported in search summary of PMC6164802 / MDPI Materials 11(9):1740)
items.notes: Book check (arithmetic only): imm-2000t 331.8 kW avg ÷ 0.6 kWh/kg = 553 kg/h; ÷ 1.47 = 226 kg/h. imm-200t 47.6 kW ÷ 0.6 = 79 kg/h; ÷ 1.47 = 32 kg/h. The book's power draws are consistent only with the ecoinvent all-in average (machine + auxiliaries), not with machine-only SECs of 0.16–0.6 kWh/kg.

items.basis: derived from a machine-hour-rate calculator's worked example: €400,000 machine, 10-year life, €12,000/yr maintenance, 2,000 h/yr → 12,000 ÷ 400,000 = 3 %
items.notes: An illustration, not a survey. Book ratio maintenance ÷ depreciation is ≈0.45 on most B-group lines (e.g. imm-2000t 72,690 ÷ 159,896) = 4.5 % of capex if the book used a 10-year life.

items.basis: Ajax TOCCO-sourced example in Heat Treat Today: 1,135 kg load × 0.56 kJ/kg°C × ~843 °C austenitise ÷ 0.65 efficiency ≈ 0.805×10^6 kJ per cycle → 805,000 ÷ 3,600 = 224 kWh ÷ 1,135 kg = 0.197 kWh/kg
items.notes: Heating the load only — excludes idle, atmosphere, quench and temper. A single example, not a typical value.

notes: Web fetch was blocked in this session (egress proxy 403 / DNS failure on every page tried), so figures come from search-result summaries with their URLs; publish dates were taken from the summaries and are marked 'not visible' where the snippet gave none. Re-open each URL to confirm date and scope before use.
No FX was sourced, so EUR / CHF / USD / INR figures are left in their own currency; convert at the stated date's Bank of England rate before use.

34 web searches used. Most makers (Engel, Arburg, KraussMaffei, Idra, Bühler, DISA, Inductotherm, Schuler, Lasco, Ipsen, Wheelabrator, ASM/Fuji) publish no prices; UK trade-press project figures are the main evidence and usually bundle auxiliaries, cells or buildings.

Book figures the evidence argues against (not proven): autoclave-1200mm (a £730k estimate buys a 3 m × 6 m autoclave; the book's write-off implies ≥£0.6m for a 1.2 m one); paint-line-std is 1/8 of a real automotive e-coat plant (£10m Brose) but near a small e-coat line (£750k Foleshill), so it depends on what the class means; IMM average power draws are consistent only with ecoinvent's all-in 1.47 kWh/kg, not machine-only 0.16–0.6 kWh/kg; hpdc-giga-6100t and emot-hairpin-line may be LOW against Bühler's ~CHF 10m average megacasting cell and the €10m series hairpin line.
Consistent with evidence: imm-800t / imm-2000t, hpdc-1600t, smt-line, smt-high-speed-line, al-ext-press-1800t capex orders of magnitude.
